dashboard.title: Run History
dashboard.noRunsHint: Start a run to explore your app with AI agents.

detail.noReport: No report found for this run.
detail.diaryHint: Generate a story-style diary of the agents' exploration. Uses one LLM call.
detail.diaryError: Generation failed. Check your LLM settings.

startModal.title: Start Run
startModal.llmBaseUrlHint: API Key is required when a custom endpoint is set — it is sent only to this URL, never to your own configured provider.

modeHint.read-only: All writes are blocked at the network layer. Only means shoal won't write to your app — everything agents read is still sent to the LLM provider.
modeHint.safe: Creating/editing data is allowed; irreversible actions (delete / pay / send) are avoided.
modeHint.full: No restrictions. Use only against disposable environments.

startModal.fixedRosterHint: If you have fixed personas, the run may raise agent counts so all of them join.

hall.title: Hall of Issues
hall.subtitle: All findings across every run
hall.importPlaceholder: Paste a GitHub raw or gist URL to a findings JSON…
hall.importError: Failed to load. Check the URL.
hall.noFindings: No findings yet. Start a run to discover issues.
hall.duplicatesSubtitle: Similar findings reported in multiple runs

goals.title: App Goals
goals.noSpec: No product spec yet. Start a run to discover app goals.
goals.placeholder: e.g. Users can complete the intended work without training
goals.hint: Write outcome success conditions only — not UI widgets (search, filters, badges belong in features). Edit UI-only drafts here in Hall.
goals.goalGapHint: Agents report "goal-gap" only when an outcome is blocked — not for missing UI controls.

edge.title: Product Edge
edge.noSpec: No product spec yet. Start a run to draft the product edge.
edge.none: No edge declared. Triage treats every finding as equally worth acting on until you name one.
edge.draft: Draft inferred from the app — review and make it yours.
edge.sharpEdgesPlaceholder: e.g. Every flow is keyboard-first — no mouse path is provided, on purpose
edge.tradeoffsPlaceholder: e.g. No onboarding wizard — the product assumes a trained operator
edge.hint: Name what this product is deliberately sharp about, and what it gives up to stay that way.
edge.triageHint: Triage still files every finding, but labels an issue "edge-risk" when the obvious fix would blunt one of these — so a human decides instead of the product drifting toward average.

personas.title: Fixed Personas
personas.hint: Type a short seed (e.g. "first-time user"). AI expands it using the app's product spec. Fixed members always join runs.
personas.seedPlaceholder: e.g. first-time user / someone hunting for bugs
personas.name: Name

siteMap.title: Site Map Coverage
siteMap.emptyHint: The map builds after your first run from sitemap.xml and paths discovered during exploration.
siteMap.noUnvisited: All known paths have been visited at least once.

triage.none: No triage result for this run — it never reached triage, or every finding was handled as a comment on an existing issue.
triage.legacy: This run's triage result predates per-issue records, so only the counts are available. From the next run on, which findings merged into which issue is kept too.
triage.noTracker: No tracker configured, so there is no URL (the HTML report still has it)
triage.unprocessedHint: Triage ended before reaching these. Run `shoal triage` to process them later.

adoption.title: Finding adoption
adoption.awaiting: No filed issue has been closed yet. Once the team closes them, shoal reconciles fixed (adopted) against not planned (rejected) and feeds that back into the next run's persona design.
adoption.hint: Lenses with high adoption produce findings the team acts on. Low-adoption lenses are dialled back but never removed — a rejected finding may just be low priority.

cost.title: LLM cost
cost.missing: {{count}} run(s) have no cost estimate and are not in the total.
